senses.gloss: to call together (cmp. כְּלֵי II); to call out, announce. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 19">Mishp. 19</cite> <he>וכשהמלאך כּוֹרֵז האדם בשלום</he> as long as the angel cries out (‘give honor to the image of God’), man is safe.

<cite ref="Exodus 19">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 33:23">Job XXXIII, 23</cite>) <he>אם יהא מן אותן אלף כורז וכ׳</he> if there be one out of the thousand (angels) crying out before him, to proclaim a man’s righteousness.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:6">Esth. R. to VI, 12</cite> <cite ref="K00375"><he>כּוֹרֵז</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K01111"><he>כָּרוֹז</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 4:4">Deut. R. s. 4</cite> <he>והכרוזות כּוֹרְזִין וכ׳</he> and the criers (angels) call out before him, Give room &c., v. infra.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="K01134">same</cite>. Tanḥ. l. c. <he>ואחד מהם מַכְרִיז … תנו וכ׳</he> and one of them (the angels) cries out before him, saying, Give honor &c.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 670:6">Yalk. Ps. 670</cite> <he>מַכְרִיזִין</he>, v. <cite ref="A01592"><he>אִיקוֹנְיָא</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:1">B. Mets. II, 1</cite>, sq. <he>אלו חייב להַכְרִיז</he> the following finds one must publish.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 28b:6">Ib. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אבידתא מַכְרִיז</he> the crier announces that something has been found (not defining the object), opp. to <he>גלימא מכריז</he> ‘a cloak’ (or whatever the object may be).—

<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:13">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה הקב״ה מכריז עליהם וכ׳</he> Ms. M. there are three persons for whose sake the Lord sends out the crier every day (to announce their praise); a. fr.
